title: Format/String mutates receiver for negative durations, so a second call gives a wrong result
property: Formatting the same *Durafmt twice returns the same string, and Duration() is unchanged by formatting
actual: first call "-1 microsecond", second call "-"; Duration() returns +1µs after formatting (d.duration = -d.duration is written back to the receiver while d.input still starts with '-')
evidence: Format is a pure formatting method (String() is also used by fmt via Stringer, and Duration() is a getter); the code negates d.duration in place at durafmt.go:94 whenever input[0]=='-', so each call flips the sign again and formatting has side effects.
